entries.value: Decline. Better leave this mystery unsolved for now.

entries.name: IntroText
entries.value: Ranger, you have brought us a very intriguing specimen. Equipment that has passed through a black hole sometimes exhibits properties that standard diagnostics cannot detect. Our specialists believe such devices may retain unstable structural changes — a technological imprint of the black hole. We can conduct an in-depth investigation and try to identify a hidden bonus. The procedure takes <color=255,0,0>1 day</color>, during which the specimen will remain in our laboratory. Please note that success is not guaranteed. We may find nothing, and repeated attempts carry a growing risk of permanent damage. Scientific progress also requires funding, especially when it may explode on the laboratory table. Our scientists have additionally discovered that this equipment can hold a second micromodule, bypassing the usual single-module restriction.
